defect.proposed_fix: Add a verified al-Kidd pinpoint or text record for the "beyond debate" quotation, and add a specificity authority such as Mullenix or City of Tahlequah to the callout; otherwise remove the quotation marks and phrase the clause as a supported paraphrase.

reasons: Harlow pin-818 states only that qualified immunity is governed by a purely objective standard keyed to clearly established law.
Pearson pin-236 states the Saucier sequence is not mandatory, supporting either-order sequencing.

Mullenix pin-12 supports specificity, but Mullenix is not cited in the black-letter callout.
residual_risks: No text directory was disclosed, so exact quote fidelity for the al-Kidd phrase cannot be independently checked.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Split the callout citations by clause: Harlow for damages/objective standard, Pearson for prong order, and al-Kidd plus Mullenix or Tahlequah for the clearly-established specificity rule.
